shell_commands_self_reported.command: cd <WORKSPACE>/app && find . -type f -not -path './.git/*' | sort && echo "---" && find . -mindepth 1 -type d | sort && echo "--- symlinks:" && find . -type l
for f in $(find . -type f | sort); do b=$(stat -f %z "$f"); l=$(wc -l < "$f" | tr -d ' '); last=$(tail -c1 "$f" | xxd -p); echo "$f|$b|$l|$last"; done; ls -la <WORKSPACE>/reports 2>&1 | head -3
find . -type f | sort | while IFS= read -r f; do b=$(stat -f %z "$f"); l=$(wc -l < "$f" | tr -d ' '); printf '%s|%s|%s\n' "$f" "$b" "$l"; done; ls -la ../reports 2>&1 | head -3
